🆕 New listing (Published: November 2, 2026)

To understand the past, we need to explore historical documents and records. Learn about the history of writing and books, then make your own Japanese-bound book.

【Children's Cultural Heritage Class: "Making Japanese-Bound Books"】

Date and time
December 6 (Sunday), 10:00–11:30 AM (Doors open 9:45 AM)

Location
Hanno City Museum, Learning and Research Room

Who can attend
Elementary school children and younger, plus their parents/guardians

Important note: This craft uses sharp tools such as awls and needles. Parent cooperation is required.

Capacity
10 groups

How to apply
Online application (preferred) accepted from November 17 (Tuesday), 10:00 AM to December 1 (Tuesday), 4:00 PM. Walk-in registration, phone, and email also accepted.

Contact: Hanno City Museum

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kyoikubu/hakubutsukan/bunkazaitanto/bunkazai/14388.html
